capabilities: Toggle fullscreen for the active pane
Hide sidebars, tabs, ribbon and status bar
Keep workspace layout unchanged on exit
Expose fullscreen CSS classes for themes and snippets
disambiguation: Not window-level fullscreen; it only makes the active pane fullscreen and does not move or resize the Obsidian window.
extras: Not available on iPhone or iPad (iOS lacks partial-page fullscreen; the command shows a notice); untested on Android. Requires Obsidian 0.15.4 or newer. Only the active pane goes fullscreen; split panes and other tabs are hidden until exit. A short Esc press does not exit fullscreen; hold Esc for a couple of seconds or use the toggle command.
problem: Obsidian's sidebars, tabs, ribbon and status bar stay visible when you want to work on a single note without distractions.
summary: Focus-mode plugin that shows the active pane fullscreen, hiding sidebars, tabs, ribbon and status bar while keeping the workspace layout intact.
